svg.title: How an answer comes to be
svg.desc: Before use, npm run generate has Gemini write 30 CV PDFs; npm run index has Gemini extract a profile from each, the field check locates every fact in the text so each has a page, and each chunk is embedded into Pinecone. At question time the chat screen sends the question and history to POST /api/ask, whose prompt holds no CV text. Gemini runs a tool-calling loop: three exact tools read the index, search_cv_text embeds the query and fuses BM25 with the vectors. The loop ends with present; the answer check keeps only the candidates and pages the tools returned, and the answer streams to the chat, whose source links open the PDF at the cited page. before use: npm run generate → CV PDFs → Gemini → Field check → data/index. embedding: CV PDFs → Embedding → Pinecone. a question: Chat screen → POST /api/ask → Gemini → find_candidates, count_candidates, get_candidates → data/index. an answer: Gemini → present → Answer check → Chat screen.
svg.text: BEFORE USE: NPM RUN GENERATE, NPM RUN INDEX
